answer: The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. The window charges 160 stamped dockets, each costing £44 to have checked before it opens, and the anchor is that the fee never comes back. A name without Ratified plasterer gold charter is turned away at the counter, and a charter plasterers sign after lime checks is the reason the counter can tell. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. plume stays on the record. One violet, one entry.
